'''Henzen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] living in [[New Adasta]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. 

In [[3636 BBY]], when the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians, Doctor Henzen remained unaffected by the madness and treated the wounded. When an associate of [[Lana Beniko]] was traveling through New Adasta, Henzen noticed that they were not yet possessed as well, and asked them to scan the area for distress beacons set by other survivors. Henzen intended to send assistance to beacons' coordinates, to get the survivors to safety and provide them with medical aid.<ref name="Searching for Survivors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Henzen was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.
